::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 23 rd 1878  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Mrs Clare Roels
:::

My dear [Christabel](people/person_329.qmd)

I do not think I have ever answered you about [Cherry](other_books/otherbook_902.qmd), but I have had my cousin [Duke Yonge](people/person_1599.qmd) here, and then a fierce Saturday of harvest decorations which raged from morn till dewy eve and by means of bulrushes, berries wheat, and those arching grasses at whose gathering I think you assisted turned out well.[^1] I begin to think now that I did write, but I cant make sure, and so I go on to say that I shall welcome Cherry after [Heriots choice](other_books/otherbook_878.qmd) and all the more if you can cut Ruth down.

Are you looking for a curate, for there is rather a good Irish friend of [Miss Finlaison](people/person_512.qmd)s a Mr Arthur Young going to leave Alresford for the odd reason that the old Rector does not like his doing so much in the schools.

your affectionate
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: CMY was offering to serialize Coleridge's novel *An English Squire* in *MP* in succession to Rosa Nouchette Carey's *Heriot's Choice*.
